scripts.data:dev: uv run python -m playlens_ml.data.preprocess --dataset nfl_bdb_2026_analytics --subset dev
scripts.data:full: uv run python -m playlens_ml.data.preprocess --dataset nfl_bdb_2026_analytics --subset full
scripts.lint: pnpm --filter web lint && uv run ruff check .
scripts.format: pnpm --filter web format && uv run ruff format .
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter web typecheck && uv run mypy services/api ml
scripts.test: pnpm --filter web test && uv run pytest
